annotations.title: Correlation spectrum vs Marchenko-Pastur for one network (paid)

description: Paid: 10 credits ($10) per answered call, charged once and only after a non-empty answer is computed; an unavailable answer, a refusal or an error costs nothing. Send your API key in the X-API-Key header or as api_key. Each call is a new answer and a new charge (no idempotency key). For one DePIN network: the correlation matrix of the daily log changes of its measured first-party metrics over the last `days` complete UTC days, its eigenvalues, and the Marchenko-Pastur edges for the same number of independent series (q = N / (T-1)). Reports the largest eigenvalue over the upper edge, how many eigenvalues exceed it, the absorption ratio (variance share of the top ceil(N/5) eigenvalues) and each metric's loading on the top eigenvector. The edge is a reference for independent light-tailed series; telemetry changes are neither, so exceeding it describes co-movement and is not a test. Uses up to `max_metrics` (3-60, default 30) metrics, by name order. Every input daily close is returned with its as_of and verify_url. No regime label, position size or trading mode is produced.

api_key.description: Your API key, only if your client cannot send the X-API-Key header.

days.description: Daily changes in the window (default 30), ending at the latest complete UTC day.

metric_filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of metric names, e.g. GPU.

symbol.description: One network ticker, e.g. AKT, FIL, RENDER.
